lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters of varying diameters, most concentrated in the medial region posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a visible grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-value intensity on the superior edge and low-value shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of at least five elongated dark silhouettes (commensal organisms) trailing beneath the ventral-posterior margin of the pectoral fin; significant caustic light patterning from surface refraction is projected onto the posterior flank.
